role: Emits Lit custom elements; styling delegated to CSS
realises: Emits Lit custom elements. Styling is delegated wholly to the CSS binding.
note: Declares only what this platform adds to or changes from the CSS binding. A style key absent here is bound exactly as css.json states; this file never restates one. Props are NOT inherited: how a prop becomes a property or attribute is this platform's own surface, declared in full below.

boolean.realises: a `boolean` member of the element's contract, reflected as an attribute
boolean.notes: The contract types and defaults are the shared platform-neutral derivation — the same module React uses. Reflection follows the shared attribute rule: the bare attribute where the name is free, the `data-` form where it collides with a global attribute that already has behaviour.

string.realises: a `string` member of the element's contract, nullable-widened with `null`
string.notes: Widened to admit `null` by the shared nullability rule (ADR-065). `examples` feed stories; they never become a contract default.

enum.realises: a named union type, reflected as an attribute the stylesheet selects on
enum.notes: Values are lowercased by the enumCase contract. The element reflects the prop so the stylesheet can select `:host([<attr>="<value>"])`; the attribute spelling comes from the one shared function the emitter and the stylesheet both call, so the two cannot disagree. Reserved global names (`hidden`, `title`, `id`, every `aria-*`) fall back to `data-<attr>`.

number.realises: a `number` member of the element's contract
number.notes: Shared contract derivation. A closed `enum` of numbers reflects and selects like an enum does, on the numeric spelling.

slot.realises: `<slot>` projection — the default slot unnamed, others named
slot.notes: A slot prop never reaches the platform-neutral contract; the custom element projects it through `<slot>`. The projection shape — unnamed for the declared `defaultSlot`, `<slot name="…">` otherwise — is the intended rule and the emitter carries slot projection code, but the per-case behaviour has not been confirmed the way the React cluster has.

image.notes: Expected to mirror the React binding — registry pointers resolve to served asset URLs — but not yet confirmed against the emitter.

object.realises: a named member interface; values as object literals
object.notes: The contract spells the object shape as its own interface (ADR-111), from the same shared derivation as React. Stories and controls work on the flat dotted-arg-key view and reassemble the object in this emitter's idiom.

emit: nothing — the prop leaves the contract; the CSS binding selects on the browser pseudo-class
cases.why: Hover, focus, active are the browser's to drive; a consumer cannot meaningfully set them

emit: the prop stays a property; the element writes the concept's aria attribute when it is set
cases.why: Disabled, selected, invalid are consumer-set facts the DOM should also state

emit: the prop is an ordinary property
otherwise.why: A prop no state entry names is not a state

statesToContract.notes: Identical rule to the React binding by construction: the concept table — selector and contract disposition per concept — is one shared module, so the two emitters and the CSS transform cannot disagree.

text.realises: a `span` in the shadow tree carrying the element's content
text.notes: `span` by default — or the tag a role decides, through the same shared precedence module React uses.

glyph.realises: expected to mirror the React mask-painted span
glyph.notes: The emitter carries a glyph module mirroring React's, but its per-case behavior has not been confirmed the way React's has.

vector.realises: a styled `div` occupying the vector's box
vector.notes: Path geometry is not in the spec on any platform; the box emits, the shape is lost.

container.realises: a `div` in the shadow tree — or the tag its role decides
container.notes: The host element is the component root (`:host` in the stylesheet); containers are shadow-tree structure beneath it.

slot.realises: `<slot>` projection — unnamed for the declared default slot, named otherwise
slot.notes: The intended rule, matching the props surface's declaration; per-case behavior not yet confirmed.

instance.notes: The emitter carries an instance module mirroring React's; role routing and configuration spelling not yet confirmed.

rectangle.notes: The one shape the platform speaks natively.

polygon.realises: a styled `div` — box only, no shape
polygon.notes: Point data is not in the spec; declared lost, as on React.

star.realises: a styled `div` — box only, no shape

inputs.from: declared conventions, through the shared concept table

emit: the role's tag, inside the shadow tree
tagCases.why: A role names a control the platform has a native element for
The structural default — no phrasing-context arm here; the shadow tree starts its own content model

emit: nothing from the generic path — the role emits the platform-native mechanism
ariaCases.why: Role over states for the mechanism, from the same shared module as React

args.compareTo: shared with a concept the role claimed

ariaCases.why: One prop cannot announce two ways at once

emit: the concept's aria attribute inside the shadow tree, when the driving prop is set
ariaCases.why: The generic path; selection attributes land on `:host` while a role's attributes land in the shadow tree

otherwise.why: An element with no role and no state entry keeps the pre-roles behavior

semanticsAndTags.notes: Event-handler composition is expected to mirror the React binding's handlerCases through the shared events model, and `instance` role routing the same — both left undeclared here until confirmed against this emitter. The precedence module is shared, so suppression cannot diverge.

valueForms.summary: Inherited from the CSS binding unless restated here.

surfaces.note: The platform-shaped questions this binding owes, none of which are CSS. propsToParameters, slotsToChildren and variantsToSelection graduated into concepts.props and concepts.propClusters above; variant selection itself is the CSS binding's propsToSelectors cluster.
